gapsAndLimitations.title: Discretization Error on Surface Flux Integration
gapsAndLimitations.description: Direct surface flux calculation exhibits O(h^1) discretization error due to C0 piecewise-constant element gradients. Decays monotonically with refinement.
gapsAndLimitations.impact: Requires using variational nodal reactions for strict energy conservation auditing.

gapsAndLimitations.title: Experimental Physical Hardware Validation
gapsAndLimitations.description: No physical hardware test bench or empirical thermocouple measurements are available in the codebase dataset.
gapsAndLimitations.impact: Application status remains strictly PASS_WITHIN_DECLARED_SCOPE and UNVERIFIED for hardware deployment.
